grades.quote: These definitions admit the possibility that SC instructions may spuriously fail for implementation reasons, provided progress is eventually made.
grades.reason: The passage explains part of why an SC can fail. Other harts or devices may keep writing to the reservation set, and SC may also fail spuriously for implementation reasons, though progress must eventually be made. It does not say what the SC result value indicates, such as zero for success and nonzero for failure. It is also not specific to SC.W.
